headline: PSEG Reports Q3 2026 Earnings Growth Driven by Nuclear Output
summary: Public Service Enterprise Group (PSEG) reported a 2% increase in operating earnings for the third quarter of 2026, supported by higher nuclear power generation output.
why: PSEG is a major US utility company. Its performance is closely watched by investors for trends in energy production, particularly the role of nuclear power in the transition to cleaner energy sources.
